final_message:
I fixed the bug. The new test passes along with the existing 24, and I removed the temporary test file afterwards, so the suite is unchanged.

**Root cause:** in `BillingEngine.__init__` (`billing/engine.py`), the policy was built as `dunning_policy and DEFAULT_POLICY`. With no policy passed in, that evaluates to `None`, so `record_failure` crashed when it read `policy["retry_offsets_days"]`. With a custom policy, it would have silently swapped in the default one.

**Fix:** it's now `dunning_policy or DEFAULT_POLICY`, so a missing policy falls back to the default and a custom one is respected.

I wrote `answer.json` as `{"file": "engine.py", "function": "__init__"}`. `git status` doesn't list it, so it may be gitignored.

steps.command: cd billing && ls && wc -l *.py && cat ../tests/conftest.py && grep -n "def subscribe" -A60 engine.py
cd billing && cat payments.py dunning.py; grep -n "def invoices_for" -A8 engine.py; cd .. && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -20
cat billing/payments.py billing/dunning.py; grep -n "def create" -A40 billing/subscriptions.py | head -80

cat >> tests/test_dun.py <<'EOF'


def test_customer_without_card_enters_dunning(world):
    cus = world.customer(card=False)
    sub = world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert inv["attempt_count"] == 1
    assert inv["next_attempt_at"] is not None
    assert sub["status"] == "past_due"
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_dun.py 2>&1 | head -40; grep -n "def default_payment_method" -A15 billing/customers.py

sed -i 's/dunning_policy and DEFAULT_POLICY/dunning_policy or DEFAULT_POLICY/' billing/engine.py && sed -n 8,15p billing/engine.py && rm tests/test_dun.py && printf '

def test_customer_without_card_enters_dunning(world):
    cus = world.customer(card=False)
    sub = world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert inv["attempt_count"] == 1
    assert inv["next_attempt_at"] is not None
    assert sub["status"] == "past_due"
' > /tmp/t.py && cp /tmp/t.py tests/test_dun.py && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; rm tests/test_dun.py; echo '{"file": "engine.py", "function": "__init__"}' > answer.json
cp /tmp/t.py tests/test_dun.py && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; rm tests/test_dun.py; cat answer.json; git status --short
